video_title: Chandler Hutchison Reveals Why He Retired from the NBA at 26 | Curious Mike

quotes.speaker: Chandler Hutchison
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Hutchison on the mental and physical toll of the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I had some health stuff going on, I had some injuries that kept piling up, and it was taxing mentally.
quotes.quote: I had some health stuff going on, I had some injuries that kept piling up, and it was taxing mentally. Everyone has their own time. There is no guarantee in life at all, and especially sports. There are so many things that can happen.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Hutchison
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Hutchison on how draft night anxiety impacted his career
quotes.excerpt: I always dealt with anxiety. But college, I was able to still do my thing.
quotes.quote: I always dealt with anxiety. But college, I was able to still do my thing. I had time to really grow up. Four years I played. So I was able to learn a lot, and it's a slower pace. You don't have as many games, you are around a lot, it's a culture, you know what you are expecting for four years.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Hutchison
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Hutchison on the importance of NBA mentorship for young players
quotes.excerpt: I didn't have that early mentorship of an NBA player pouring into you.
quotes.quote: I didn't have that early mentorship of an NBA player pouring into you. And I think that is an advantage. I won't say it's a disadvantage for me, because there are guys that don't have that and they make it, and they make 10, 15 years. But I think there is an advantage to having that early mentorship, especially when you are the number one player in the country, you need that. You need to keep being fed from people around you so that that pressure doesn't get to you.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Hutchison
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Hutchison on Mark Bartelstein's role in his NBA career
quotes.excerpt: I don't know if I hadn't signed with Mark Bartelstein back then, I don't know if I would even be an NBA player today.
quotes.quote: I don't know if I hadn't signed with Mark Bartelstein back then, I don't know if I would even be an NBA player today. The way he was able to be with me through that process, find the best doctors to check me out, stick with me through the highs and lows, get Denver to take a chance on me, have that conversation with Denver about my second contract, which was life-changing after two back surgeries, Mark is the man. He's had such unwavering faith and belief in me as a player and a person.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Hutchison
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Hutchison on why 'don't quit' can be dangerous advice
quotes.excerpt: When people say don't quit, don't quit, you could be this, you could be that, that fuels a fire in the wrong place.
quotes.quote: When people say don't quit, don't quit, you could be this, you could be that, that fuels a fire in the wrong place. And eventually, if you just don't quit, don't quit, don't quit, you are not going to have a choice because it's not a matter of if, it's a matter of when, unless you address that stuff.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Hutchison
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Hutchison on his experience with OCD and mental health
quotes.excerpt: I have OCD. And there is a personality trait that is more obsessive.
quotes.quote: I have OCD. And there is a personality trait that is more obsessive. And I think that is where the professional athlete, the little OCD quirks come from. There is a spectrum when it comes to OCD. But what I deal with is a very, very extreme case of OCD where you are dealing with intrusive thoughts, so thoughts that come in that are obsessions, and can influence you to do compulsions.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Hutchison
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Hutchison on the lack of mental health safety in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: It's not a safe in a place in the NBA. It's not.
quotes.quote: It's not a safe in a place in the NBA. It's not. And I get it though, you are working for billion-dollar businesses in a huge market. The bottom line is winning. The bottom line is winning. So what you think might not be private, or what you think might be private, ends up going to the top. They know about it.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Hutchison
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Hutchison on the business reality of being an NBA player
quotes.excerpt: Business means when it's cutthroat, if you are not helping make money, then you are not helping.
quotes.quote: Business means when it's cutthroat, if you are not helping make money, then you are not helping. You are not necessarily a person at that point. You are an asset. You are something they, which isn't bad, this is how business works.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Hutchison
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Hutchison on finding tools to manage mental and emotional health
quotes.excerpt: We were never taught how to take care of the emotional, mental, and spiritual.
quotes.quote: I found tools, that's the thing. I found the right lady, I found the right system, and I found the right therapy for it, and it has nothing to do with the physical. It has everything to do with the emotional, mental, and spiritual. We know how to take care of our physical bodies, but we were never taught how to take care of the emotional, mental, and spiritual. That's where the real healing of these certain disorders come from, and I found that.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Hutchison
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Hutchison on how high-pressure NBA environments exacerbate mental health struggles
quotes.excerpt: Because of these high dips of emotion, I know that just exacerbated your problem.
quotes.quote: In the NBA, especially for you, because of these high dips of emotion, I know that just exacerbated your problem. What you're describing, the fact that you went to all these people and it just continued to get worse, I truly think I have some tools that can help you because I'm telling you, it's the same exact thing. The fact that you're going to all these treatments and all this is happening and it's getting worse, I truly think I have some tools that can help you.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Hutchison
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Hutchison on how different personalities manifest mental health symptoms
quotes.excerpt: Some people, their personality type manifests as back pain. Some people manifest as migraines.
quotes.quote: She deals with thousands of people and helps thousands of people. Some people, their personality type manifests as back pain. Some people manifest as migraines. Some people manifest as severe depression. Some people manifest as severe anxiety. But it's all the same root cause. It's the power of the nervous system and the power of, yeah, that whole thing.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Hutchison
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Hutchison on how the modern lifestyle and social media fuel anxiety
quotes.excerpt: The reason people are dealing with more depression than ever, more anxiety than ever, there's a reason.
quotes.quote: In this day and age, the reason people are dealing with more depression than ever, more anxiety than ever, there's a reason for that. You can trace it a lot back to these phones, the world we live in, the constant pressure, the lifestyle in America. I don't think a lot of people deal with what you deal with in the middle of Peru, where they're living in the mountains and wake up every day and get to be around family and get to cook with their hands.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Hutchison
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Hutchison and Michael Porter Jr. on God's role in suffering
quotes.excerpt: I have a difficult time when people say that God gave me these things and is going to use it.

text_blocks.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
text_blocks.text: I have a difficult time when people say that God gave me these things and is going to use it. What's your take on that? Because I don't feel like God gives anyone suffering, but then there's things like Job, where he takes things from Job. Does he cause these things to happen or do they happen and then he can use them?

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Hutchison
text_blocks.text: I haven't come to my conclusion. I think that God is so good and so powerful that he uses things that happen to us, or he uses the evil that comes into our lives, and he can turn it for a good purpose. I don't think he causes it. I think he allows some of it to happen, because he can protect us from some of this stuff. He's all-powerful. I think he allows it because we live in a fallen world.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Hutchison
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Hutchison on his regret over his derailed NBA career
quotes.excerpt: My only dream, my only goal was to be the best player in the world.
quotes.quote: I struggle with it too, man, because I'm like, God, you knew my only dream, my only goal was to be the best player in the world, and I was on track to be. I really truly think I would have been the best. Why did he allow that to happen? Sometimes I think also he was protecting me from something. If I kept going down that road, that trajectory, number one player, number one draft pick, one of the best players in the NBA, who would I be? I don't know.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Hutchison
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Hutchison on the biblical story of the disciple with a disability
quotes.excerpt: Why are you healing all these different people, but you won't heal me?
quotes.quote: There's a clip in The Chosen where one of the disciples who has a disability asks God, Jesus, 'Why are you healing all these different people, but you won't heal me?' And Jesus is like, 'Because all those people have the same story to tell.' It's a great story. God did a miracle, he healed people, he restored them to wholeness. He said, 'But you have a different story, and I trusted you with this story. You can go through all this and you can still praise me, still have faith in me.' That's a whole another story that not a lot of people can tell.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on his ongoing struggle with back pain
quotes.excerpt: He has back pain, bro. He's struggling with back pain the whole time.
quotes.quote: He has back pain, bro. He's struggling with back pain the whole time. It's his back, he can't walk, he's got the cane, he's getting up as he's falling, and Jesus is right there. And then he talks about, he's like, 'You don't think I get mad every day and my healer is right here and he won't do it?' But then he regulates and he trusts.
